text:
linh_onboard: Heads up — NexusHealth sent back their vendor intake. It's SOC2 checklist + DPA addendum + vendor risk form. Legal flagged BYOK and cross-border processing questions. Can we triage?

maria_cs: I have the PDF, uploaded it to the thread (nexus_dpa_questions.pdf). High level: they want confirmation of key provenance and whether embeddings are stored outside EU.

kevin_se: @linh_onboard can you paste the exact question on BYOK? there are several flavors.

linh_onboard: Sure, copy/paste from Q12: "Do you support customer-provided keys (BYOK) for encryption at rest, and can you provide attestation of key origin & rotation policy?" Also Q27 asks: "Which regions might host derivative artifacts (embeddings, vector indexes)?"

sam_eng: For BYOK we support KMS integration with AWS KMS and GCP KMS. We don't currently have a hosted BYOK attestation doc — security needs to sign an endorsed statement.

maria_cs: Customer needs something by EOD Thursday to keep their procurement timeline. Is that feasible?

ops_bot: Ticket created: CS-4721 — NexusHealth vendor intake. Assigned to @taylor_security, due 2026-03-26.

kevin_se: @taylor_security can you confirm whether we can provide a short attestation letter and the canonical KMS doc link? If not, can we offer a mitigation (BYOK via Dedicated + customer-managed key)?

linh_onboard: Also note: customer asked about embeddings retention policy specifically for PHI. They're asking whether we have a mode to not persist embeddings and just use ephemeral KV cache.

sam_eng: We have two options: 1) Dedicated/Private with customer keys and retention controls, or 2) Hosted with opt-out of embeddings persistence (experimental flag) but requires SRE approval for production SLAs.

maria_cs: We'll need an answer matrix for legal: a 1‑line yes/no + path to evidence for each option (hosted BYOK, dedicated BYOK, embeddings retention opt‑out). Can someone draft?

kevin_se: I'll draft the evidence matrix and include links to the infra design + sample config snippets. Example snippet for Dedicated BYOK:```yaml
key_provider: aws-kms
kms_key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-... 
encryption_mode: customer_managed
```

linh_onboard: thanks — please keep it concise. I'll package into the intake response and loop in Legal.

maria_cs: @taylor_security any chance for a short attestation (1 paragraph) about key provenance & rotation policies? They don't need full SOC report, just confirmation of supported integrations and rotation cadence.

ops_bot: @taylor_security accepted assignment for CS-4721.

(taylor_security has joined the channel)

taylor_security: I can provide a 1-paragraph attestation and pointer to our KMS integration guide. Quick answers: we support KMS BYOK via Dedicated and Private modes; rotation policy is documented (90-day rotation recommended for customer keys, Redwood-managed keys rotate per SOC2 policy). I'll attach attestation draft in ~2 hours.

maria_cs: Amazing — if you can also confirm the embeddings retention wording (no persistence vs TTL), that's golden.

sam_eng: For hosted: we can set TTL=0 for embeddings storage to emulate ephemerality but need a config change and a short maintenance window; for dedicated/private you get full control. I'll add that to Kevin's matrix.

linh_onboard: Plan: Kevin drafts matrix + sample config, Taylor provides attestation paragraph, Sam adds the embeddings retention caveat. I'll assemble and send to Legal, aim to respond to NexusHealth by Thu EOD.

maria_cs: Got it. I'll block a 30m sync after drafts are in to review before sending. :thumbsup:

linh_onboard: Uploading nexus_response_draft.md once you all post snippets.

kevin_se: Posted matrix link: https://redwood.internal/triage/CS-4721/matrix (internal access)

ops_bot: Reminder: CS-4721 due in 48 hours.

maria_cs: Thanks team — leaning on you for the technical bits. I'll handle procurement cadence notes in the response.

linh_onboard: If anyone needs the original PDF again, it's pinned to the thread.

(taylor_security uploaded: nexus_attestation_draft.txt)

kevin_se: Reviewed attestation draft, left 2 minor comments inline.

maria_cs: Final check: who will send to Legal? I'll do it once Kevin resolves comments and Linh assembles.

linh_onboard: I'll send to Legal + cc NexusHealth procurement after our quick review. Thanks everyone!
